rules.description: BKE interactive Google sign-in, web checkout and customer renewal POST bursts (one Free WAF rule; no native/webhook challenge)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "bkedigitalsolutions.com" and http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/google/start" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/checkout" or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/subscriptions/") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/renew"))))
